import numpy as np, requests, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

b62_txt = """A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
L_=b62_txt.strip().split("\n"); aas=L_[0].split(); S={}
for ln in L_[1:]:
    p=ln.split()
    for a,v in zip(aas,p[1:]): S[(p[0],a)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return S.get((a,b),-4)

def nw(s1,s2,gop=-11,gep=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2)
    NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    PM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int); PX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int); PY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=gop+gep*(i-1); PX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=gop+gep*(j-1); PY[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1])
            c=(M[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]); k=int(np.argmax(c)); M[i,j]=c[k]+s; PM[i,j]=k
            c=(M[i-1,j]+gop,Ix[i-1,j]+gep,Iy[i-1,j]+gop); k=int(np.argmax(c)); Ix[i,j]=c[k]; PX[i,j]=k
            c=(M[i,j-1]+gop,Ix[i,j-1]+gop,Iy[i,j-1]+gep); k=int(np.argmax(c)); Iy[i,j]=c[k]; PY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; state=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if state==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]); a2.append(s2[j-1]); ns=PM[i,j]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif state==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]); a2.append('-'); ns=PX[i,j]; i-=1
        else: a1.append('-'); a2.append(s2[j-1]); ns=PY[i,j]; j-=1
        state=ns
        if i==0 and j>0: state=2
        if j==0 and i>0: state=1
    return "".join(reversed(a1)),"".join(reversed(a2))

q='protein_name:"Pyridoxal phosphate homeostasis protein" AND reviewed:true'
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",params={"query":q,"format":"fasta","size":"500"},timeout=90)
seqs={}
for block in r.text.split(">")[1:]:
    ln=block.split("\n"); hdr=ln[0]; s="".join(ln[1:])
    org=hdr.split("OS=")[1].split(" OX=")[0] if "OS=" in hdr else "?"
    seqs[org+"|"+hdr.split("|")[1]]=s
human=seqs["Homo sapiens|O94903"]
cols={i:[] for i in range(len(human))}; pairid={}; ecoli_map={}
for name,s in seqs.items():
    if name.startswith("Homo sapiens"): continue
    a1,a2=nw(human,s); hi=-1; oi=-1; ident=0; naln=0
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-': hi+=1
        if c2!='-': oi+=1
        if c1!='-':
            cols[hi].append(c2)
            if c2!='-':
                naln+=1; ident+=(c1==c2)
                if name.startswith("Escherichia coli (strain K12)"): ecoli_map[hi+1]=(c2,oi+1)
    pairid[name]=100.0*ident/naln
cons=np.array([sum(1 for x in cols[i] if x==human[i])/len(cols[i]) for i in range(len(human))])

print("Orthologues aligned (SwissProt-reviewed PLPHP family): n =", len(pairid))
print("Mean pairwise identity to human: {:.1f} percent (range {:.1f} to {:.1f})".format(
    np.mean(list(pairid.values())), min(pairid.values()), max(pairid.values())))
for k in sorted(pairid):
    if any(t in k for t in ["Escherichia coli (strain K12)","Saccharomyces","Caenorhabditis","Mus musculus","Mycobacterium tuberculosis (strain ATCC","Aquifex","Synechocystis","Dictyostelium","Bacillus subtilis"]):
        print("   human vs {:52s} {:5.1f} percent id".format(k.split('|')[0][:52], pairid[k]))

inv=[i+1 for i in range(len(human)) if cons[i]==1.0]
print("\nStrictly invariant residues across all 29 orthologues (n = {}):".format(len(inv)))
print("  "+", ".join(human[i-1]+str(i) for i in inv))
print("\nHuman K47 maps to E. coli YggS residue:", ecoli_map.get(47))
print("Conservation of K47: {:.0f} percent".format(100*cons[46]))

# conservation in the disordered C-terminal tail vs core
core=cons[:250]; tail=cons[250:]
print("\nMean conservation: core 1-250 = {:.2f}, disordered tail 251-275 = {:.2f}".format(core.mean(), tail.mean()))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.6))
ax.bar(np.arange(1,len(human)+1),cons*100,width=1.0,color="#4C78A8")
for p,lab,col in [(47,"K47 PLP Schiff base","#D62728"),(175,"L175P","#E45756"),(241,"R241Q","#E45756"),(87,"P87L","#E45756")]:
    ax.axvline(p,color=col,lw=1.2,ls="--")
    ax.text(p,106,lab,rotation=90,fontsize=7,ha="center",va="bottom",color=col)
ax.axvspan(251,275,color="grey",alpha=0.25)
ax.text(263,50,"disordered tail",rotation=90,fontsize=7,ha="center",color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("Human PLPBP residue position (O94903)")
ax.set_ylabel("Identity to human (percent of 29 orthologues)")
ax.set_title("Cross-kingdom conservation of human PLPBP maps onto the PLP-binding site")
ax.set_ylim(0,130); ax.set_yticks([0,25,50,75,100]); ax.set_xlim(0,276)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
